title: Split-word headline (Springs)
source: springs.estate intro/hero title. Engine = library/components/split-word-headline (proven, trigger:'progress'). Dual wrapper adds the mobile auto-play branch.
engine: A headline split into per-word clip rows; each WORD rises from under its own overflow:hidden clip (yPercent 120→0) + fades, staggered in a wave. Pure set(p) driver.
differs: Same per-word reveal mechanic + same pure set(p) driver. TRIGGER differs: desktop scrubs set(p) from scroll progress (reversible, scroll-linked); mobile ramps set(p) 0→1 once over time on mount (auto-play, plays once). Springs mobile hero title animates in on load; desktop resolves it as you scroll in.

desktop.driver: scrollReveal — p = scroll progress of the headline through the viewport (reversible scrub).

mobile.driver: autoReveal — p ramps 0→1 once over playMs on mount (ease-in-out), then rests.

playMs.what: auto-play duration of the one-shot cascade.

entry: SplitWordHeadlineDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = an element holding a headline (data-swh). opts.platform 'auto'|'desktop'|'mobile'.
law: transform translateY(% via yPercent) + opacity on inner word spans + overflow:hidden per-word clip only. NO layout-prop animation. GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL. reduced-motion → all words shown (no travel) on both platforms.
